answer: Charge a registration fee that rises along a spiral bonding curve: the first identity from a funding source costs little, but each additional identity from the same source costs quadratically more, like quartz crystals that grow dearer as the vein deepens. The fee sits in escrow and is returned only after the identity sustains honest work; umber-stained failures forfeit it. A Sybil attacker funding a thousand sock puppets pays a superlinear total, while a single honest agent pays almost nothing.
